# CancerNotes

> Understand cancer, one card at a time. A free, private mobile companion app for iOS and Android organised around 118 cancer types.

CancerNotes is an information and organisation app for patients, caregivers, family members, students, and advocates. It brings together recent cancer news from third-party publishers, AI-generated educational quick tips, self-test quizzes with explanations, and a private on-device notebook. No account or sign-up is required.

## Key Facts

- Platforms: iPhone (iOS) and Android
- Price: Free (no in-app purchases in the current build)
- Account required: No
- Library: 118 cancer types (from common to rare and childhood cancers), plus unlimited custom topics
- Five tabs: Cancers, Notes, Trending, Saved, Quizzes
- Quiz options: Easy, Medium, Hard; 5 to 20 questions; True/False, single answer, select all that apply
- Quick Tips: 10 swipeable plain-language fact cards per session
- Offline support: Notes, saved articles, quiz history, and previously opened tips and quizzes work offline; trending news requires an internet connection
- Data storage: Notes, saved articles, quiz history, and custom topics are stored on the device only

## Important Disclaimer

CancerNotes is for information and learning only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always talk to your care team about your health.
